Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “RSL” as “reduced salinity level” instead of “relative sea level,” and then incorrectly framed option B as involving a drop in salinity/density. This conflated sea-level fall (which supports option B: reduced ocean volume/area) with salinity changes (option A), leading to misleading instructions and reasoning that could steer toward the wrong mechanism.
